summary: Iter29 backend-only validation: 22/22 pytest cases PASS. Verified config refactor still boots (settings singleton in use), Sentry no-op init log line present after restart, 17/17 indexes created (incl. ix_waitlist_email unique, ix_waitlist_created, ix_users_founder sparse), Founding Member assignment on /api/auth/signup (founder_number 1 and 2, badge added, points>=55, 'Founding Member #N' notification inserted, demo users excluded), /api/founders/status returns correct cap/taken/remaining/open, /api/waitlist idempotency by lower-cased email, EmailStr 422, 5-per-10-min rate-limit returns 429, /api/waitlist/stats source aggregation (facebook=2, flyer=1), /api/admin/waitlist + mark-invited admin gating (200/403/404 + idempotent), regressions: /api/health ok, /api/auth/me reflects founder fields, /api/auth/login still works, iter28 signup 5/IP rate-limit still fires. Pre-existing benign passlib bcrypt stderr warning observed and ignored as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: _assign_founder_status uses non-atomic count→insert (server.py:456). At MVP traffic this is acceptable (and the code comment acknowledges it) but two concurrent signups can both observe `current=X` and both insert founder_number=X+1. Consider $inc on a counter doc or a unique index on founder_number for hard guarantees before launch promo.
Rate-limit on /api/waitlist runs BEFORE pydantic validation, so malformed-email POSTs still consume bucket slots. Likely intentional (anti-abuse) but worth confirming with PM.
server.py is 6302 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers/ per domain (auth, waitlist, founders, events, moderation, community, games).
seed_data_creation: All test data (founder_test_<runtag>_* users, iter29test_<runtag>_* waitlist entries, 'Founding Member #' notifications) was cleaned up in the autouse fixture teardown — verified 0 residual rows in users/waitlist after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter29 added: pydantic-settings config singleton, optional Sentry init, founding-member badge logic at signup (capped via FOUNDING_MEMBER_CAP=500, demos excluded), waitlist endpoints + admin gating, 3 new Mongo indexes. Test file `test_iter29_founders_waitlist_sentry.py` restarts backend in autouse fixture to reset in-process rate-limit buckets. Reuse pattern when testing rate-limited endpoints. Note that /api/waitlist rate-limit runs before validation so even 422-bound calls consume slots.
